function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw difference in response rates between treatment and control arms is confounded by baseline severity, as treatment was assigned by clinician judgement and sicker patients were more likely to receive treatment. To estimate the true treatment effect, we must adjust for severity. We will compute the treatment effect within each severity stratum (mild, moderate, severe) and then compute a weighted average of the stratum-specific effects, using the overall distribution of severity as weights. This is a standard approach to adjust for confounding in non-randomised studies. The resulting adjusted difference in proportions will be the valid estimate of the treatment effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
